summary: Phase 149O.20L.7B.2 -- Dell Class-B Boundary-P Authorization Record Re-Capture. AUTHORIZATION-RECORD CAPTURE ONLY. Read Phase 149O.20L.7B.1's full 1209-line document and reconstructed its amended proposition exactly: pinned source SHA 7a3fa971304521cdcb44251e07ef1966baec686a, exact nine-action command plan, exact launch-wrapper content/digest b3e969128ff48ecfae874a9348d889b43f7fc336bf170387b912b1cfc3753c32, repo-slug future-template-only scope clarification, and the Action-9 finding (infrastructure provisioning cannot honestly claim full COMPLIANT; expected NON_COMPLIANT driven only by HBDC-REQ-042, due to the intentionally absent DeploymentBinding). Independently re-reconfirmed this phase, live and read-only: Dell identity (machine-id 54ff22ce400b475aa0d55cb68f4a3334, hostname atila-Latitude-E5470, Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS, amd64) with no material drift (no pcae principal/group/paths, codex sudo posture unchanged, python3-pip still absent); source binding (7a3fa971304521cdcb44251e07ef1966baec686a still origin/main's ancestor, contains all three governing contracts and the Class-B verifier, zero src/pcae/**|scripts/**|docs/contracts/** changes since that commit); contract versions (HBDC-001 v1.0, HMIC-001 v1.3, HMRC-001 v1.1, all unchanged, HBDC-REQ-042 and the verifier's NON_COMPLIANT-by-default docstring re-confirmed present). Presented the complete proposition to the human governance authority in full -- host, source, deployment identity, admin channel, paths, nine-action graph, Action 1 package caveat, Action 8 wrapper bytes/digest/environment contract, the mandatory Action-9 disclosure distinguishing the expected residual from any unexpected conformance failure, all exclusions (no DeploymentBinding/Boundary C/Boundary A/Cutover Record/Permission Broker/centralized governance/etc.), the semantic-distinction restatement, the privileged-operation disclosure, the rollback disclosure, the product model, and the migration-scoping statement -- with the authority wall (invocation is not an election; no default; no inference; no carry-forward from the prior AMEND session) restated immediately before the election request. Human elected APPROVE, verbatim, first-person, with a separate explicit confirmation obtained twice (once on the selection, once again on the exact rendered pcae decision-session preview content and digest). Two operator errors in evidence declaration occurred and were disclosed honestly rather than hidden or forced through: one decision session (CDS-506d69fd-...) was cancelled after its evidence citation used the wrong commit (repository HEAD instead of the commit that actually introduced the 149O.20L.7B.1 document); a second (CDS-e020f5a5-...) was cancelled after its correction attempt itself used a fabricated, hand-padded 40-character string instead of running git rev-parse to obtain the real full SHA -- pcae decision-session evidence does not allow re-declaration once a session leaves Created state, so cancellation-and-recreation was the only available remedy, never force or silent overwrite. The session actually carried to completion, CDS-adb67041-3a30-4b4e-a188-e6284e7743be, correctly declared three evidence items (the real full SHA of the commit introducing 149O.20L.7B.1's document, the pinned source SHA, and the wrapper digest), recorded the APPROVE selection with the human's verbatim rationale/conditions, rendered and had the human separately confirm the exact preview content (preview_digest e49caf228bdbddda27277f1b37ad06cd71bd68a60bd5aa6a8faacd50d899033d), reached Confirmed state, and produced a persisted readiness package (prp-66418889a03e42379213a2f50340d362). pcae governance-record publish then published a new Dell-specific CHGR, chgr-96a0ce12756e4cc892492a87af1db832, which was independently inspected (lifecycle_state published, selected_option_id approve, decision_subject naming the Dell by machine-id and citing the 149O.20L.7B.1 proposition, rationale/conditions preserving the Action-9 disclosure verbatim) and verified (7 of 7 substantive checks passed -- schema_shape, digest_self_consistency, lifecycle_structural_legality, confirmation_binding, assurance_truthfulness, provenance_consistency, integrity_consistency -- with template_resolution skipped, independently reproduced as the same pre-existing expected behavior the historical Mac CHGR also exhibits, not a regression). The prior AMEND session CDS-cf123bbf-a5d7-4f0f-ac22-0baa257990af was independently re-queried after this phase's own publication and remains Confirmed/amend, unchanged. The historical Mac CHGR chgr-d4343fa51b9743f3abaeb87a881a78b1 was independently re-inspected after this phase's own publication and remains published, still naming Atilas-MacBook-Pro.local, unmodified, not reused. No Dell mutation occurred at any point -- every Dell command this phase was read-only, and the entire decision-session/readiness/publication sequence executed locally against this repository's own .pcae/ state, with no network call to the Dell. No src/pcae/**, docs/contracts/**, or scripts/** file was touched -- confirmed via git diff --name-only HEAD at phase close. Boundary P is now AUTHORIZED BY PUBLISHED DELL-SPECIFIC CHGR -- INDEPENDENT AUTHORIZATION VERIFICATION PENDING; Boundary C/A remain NOT AUTHORIZED; Class-B remains NOT PROVISIONED; HATP remains NOT READY; runtime unchanged. New, independently authored companion test module -- 45 tests, re-run three consecutive times, 45 passed each run, no flake -- asserting the prior AMEND session's preservation, the historical Mac CHGR's preservation, the new session's/CHGR's exact bindings (Dell machine-id, pinned source SHA, wrapper digest, Action-9 disclosure), the absence of any DeploymentBinding/Boundary-C/Boundary-A authorization language, and that the actual git diff touches no src/pcae/**, docs/contracts/**, or scripts/** path. Recommends exactly one next phase: 149O.20L.7C -- Dell Class-B Boundary-P Authorization Independent Verification, to independently reconstruct and attack the new CHGR before any privileged mutation is even considered. Not begun by this phase.
